title: dictyophleba lucida
intro: Dictyophleba lucida, commonly known as the African Butter Tree or African Butter Fruit, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of West and Central Africa. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dictyophleba lucida include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, such as ursolic acid and oleanolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
